extensionDescription.message: Enhance YouTube Picture-in-Picture with better playback controls.

optionsPageDescription.message: Customize playback controls for the FloatPlay mini player.

optionsSeekBackwardDescription.message: Amount used by the back button and Left Arrow shortcut.

optionsSeekForwardDescription.message: Amount used by the forward button and Right Arrow shortcut.

optionsTimeDisplayDescription.message: Choose what the first time value beside the timeline represents.

optionsVolumeStepDescription.message: Amount changed by the mouse wheel and Up/Down Arrow shortcuts.

optionsAutoHideDescription.message: Hide controls during playback after a period of inactivity.

optionsAutoHideDelayDescription.message: How long FloatPlay waits after the last interaction before hiding controls.

optionsShortcutsDescription.message: Shortcut keys are fixed in v1 and apply while the mini player is focused.

optionsApplyNotice.message: Reload open YouTube tabs after saving to apply the new settings.

optionsInvalidForm.message: Check the highlighted settings before saving.

optionsSaved.message: Settings saved. Reload open YouTube tabs to apply them.

optionsResetDone.message: Default settings restored. Reload open YouTube tabs to apply them.

optionsSaveError.message: Unable to save settings. Try again.
